thread:
Nina (CSE): ACME iOS team reporting short-lived 429s immediately after a rollout; a few 401s on token refresh too. only within the first ~10 minutes.
ACME Mobile: our app calls init on cold start and again when starting a new chat. token TTL is 5m and we rotate often.
Jun (Support): sounds like a startup stampede + token overlap. do you debounce/reuse init results client-side?
ACME Mobile: nope, each controller calls init independently.
Omar (Eng): two-pronged approach: 1) upgrade to SDK v0.9.3 which adds singleflight/debounce for init and exposes initDebounceMs; 2) we can provision a temporary warmup bypass / quota bump for their account during onboarding (SRE approval needed).
Nina (CSE): sending the 0.9.3 artifact and a suggested config.

```
// iOS suggestion
RedwoodSDK.configure(
  apiKey: "<ephemeral>",
  initDebounceMs: 3000,
  autoRetry: true
)
```

Jun (Support): recommend they also increase token TTL to >=2m during the ramp to avoid refresh storms. ask them to run a stepped ramp (10 -> 100 -> 1000) and capture x-rate-limit-* headers and any 401 payloads.
Omar (Eng): opened infra ticket for a temporary quota bump / warmup-bypass for account 34721; tagging eng-sre for signoff.
deploy-bot: infra/ISSUE-919 created  warmup-bypass request for acct 34721. Canary window proposed. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/warmup-bypass
Liz (CSM): I'll coordinate a support window at 22:00 PST for the test and be on the call.
ACME Mobile: confirmed, we'll upgrade tonight and post logs after the ramp. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
